t: This is Lambeth North tube station, at the junction of Westminster Bridge Road and Baylis Road. It's on the Bakerloo line, between Waterloo and Elephant & Castle, in fare zone 1. It's the nearest station for the Imperial War Museum, and in 2017 it was ranked the least-used in zone 1. Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for his Underground stations of the 1900s, with oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars, and semi-circular first-floor windows.
